traversal_rules.structural_check: Ignore progression, discovery and encounter requirements for graph connectivity.
traversal_rules.gated_check_pending: Physical map continuity, collisions, base-story bypass and save recovery require ROM integration tests.
traversal_rules.ferries: Ordinary dock-to-dock boat connections, no instant town teleport network; no timetable wait required.
traversal_rules.late_campaign_boundaries: Late towns and encounters use gate.late_campaign: eight original Badges plus relevant pre-League travel/story milestones, never Champion victory. All 24 towns, 96 secrets and 12 additional gyms are main-campaign content.
traversal_rules.base_world_gate_migration: The abstract original Unova node does not prove original-world availability. Migrate every originally later-locked base area, encounter, item, facility and upgrade to pre-N milestones and audit indirect dependencies against the ROM.
traversal_rules.final_challenge: Original eight gym victories plus twelve additional emblems may gate the final N battle, but N’s defeat gates no world node or exclusive collectible.
traversal_rules.after_champion: Only optional sages search and rematches, without exclusive collectible or world rewards.
